childWelcomeTheme: Lavender, peach and plum; green Start and yellow narrator unchanged. Story palettes unchanged.
description: Review-only Who Helps Where candidate. Every child receives the same matched six-story set at Home and at School, for twelve helping-choice stories total. Home-first versus School-first is counterbalanced. Character ratings and all Likert follow-ups are removed.
questionAudioTiming: new NaturalReaders Evelyn recordings with the Home/School context first and natural comma timing
questionContextPlacement: Each helping question begins with 'At the kid's house,' or 'At the kid's school,' followed by the helping question.
editingPreviewControls: Temporary Back and Skip controls appear in actual CHS Preview Study launches and separate review paths. Official live participant launches remain tool-free, even if URL flags request controls.
locationCaptionTreatment: The Home or School sentence appears once in the palette-colored top caption; the former blue-and-white lower card is inactive.
narratorMouthTiming: The yellow narrator mouth starts on actual media playback and stops on buffering, pause, abort, emptied media, end, error, or researcher navigation.
contextIntroduction: After each character appears and is introduced, the story says, 'They are all at the kid's house' or 'They are all at the kid's school.'
entranceSequence: Exterior caption and Evelyn narration, zoom toward door, door opens, entry hallway, room introduction, then cumulative character introductions. Twelve stories and matched context blocks are unchanged.
entranceArtwork: Approved shared house and school exteriors; both entry halls now match each assigned story palette. The classroom floor mask is corrected across all 17 palettes without changing furniture or character artwork.
captionTreatment: A single picture-relative font size, padding and minimum height across entrances and story pages; longer questions wrap without shrinking the font.
visualTreatment: Furnished Home and School rooms with subtle palette-matched walls. In the Home room, only the empty artwork field and four original wooden frame bars receive a faint same-hue palette tint inside fixed hard masks; the picture mat and shadow, surrounding wall, lamp, natural wooden floor, neutral couch and cast shadow remain untouched. The abstract picture people are removed, pillows and selected furniture details remain shared gray, and the original character RGB and geometry remain unchanged.
visualIntegrity: Edge-connected and very large pure-white background components are transparent in both story and follow-up layers. The fixed enclosed white strip between the middle adult's legs and the box is also removed from the 24 directional Help foregrounds. Eye whites, white label text, characters, boxes, and colored captions remain opaque; retained opaque RGB pixels are unchanged.
participantSafety: The runtime preflights prerecorded Evelyn narration for both Home and School before starting. All 18 role-set by event by context-order cells have complete coverage; browser speech is not substituted.
palettePlan: Each six-story block uses six distinct exact palette slugs. The matched Home and School versions of a story deliberately keep the same palette, side, and rendition so only setting changes.
